title: Claude Fable 5 AI finds a tiny formula that topples an 87-year-old math conjecture
summary: A mathematician working at Anthropic says he used the AI model Claude Fable 5 to uncover a remarkably simple counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture, a famous problem that has resisted mathematicians for more than a century.
